notes_for_editor: Build year not pinned. Clio gives only the 1930s. Two search snippets (livingnewdeal.org, sah-archipedia.org) point to a Camp Price CCC camp set up in 1935; neither page was read (SAH returned HTTP 403), so no year is claimed. Fetch livingnewdeal.org before stating a date. The archive photo (pocahontaspreservation.org item 577) is not added to photos because its rights line only says 'See Rights and Reproductions'. The state park history page had no tower mention. The waymarking.com page yielded no text. Record county and coordinates agree with FFLA and Wikipedia. Agency changed from the builder (CCC, per Clio; kept in events) to the managing agency, West Virginia State Parks, from the archive tags. Wikipedia's infobox lists the governing body as the West Virginia Division of Natural Resources; not used here.
